note: The core list is the static import closure of the roots, with the package initialisation of every member and without the lazy package map. It is rewritten only by `scripts/core_layer_gate.py --write-baseline` in a reviewed change; the gate is red when the measured closure differs from it in either direction.

trust_boundaries.cryptography: required dependency (pyproject `dependencies`): the Ed25519, ECDSA and X.509 primitives the core verifies with
trust_boundaries.rfc8785: required dependency (pyproject `dependencies`): the RFC 8785 JCS canonicaliser the core hashes and compares with
trust_boundaries.opentimestamps: optional extra `[anchors]`: the OpenTimestamps proof library behind the OTS anchor verifier, imported only when an anchor is verified
trust_boundaries.rfc3161_client: optional extra `[anchors]`: the RFC 3161 token verifier behind the TSA anchor verifier, imported only when an anchor is verified
